records.context: The warm-up polishes before it shows. Qt posts every new widget a ``PolishRequest``, and a dialog built ahead in an idle slice (:func:`_warm_the_preferences`) answers it in the next pass of the event loop, long before :meth:`setVisible`. The window sheet and the glass then walked all ~967 widgets of every tab in that one event: 425-484 ms offscreen, 0.36 s on the lesson capture host. The pages leave here as they would at the show, and the polish styles the open tab only.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences._preferences_window_class._PreferencesWindow.event#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: THE WARM-UP POLISHES BEFORE IT SHOWS. Qt posts every new widget a ``PolishRequest``, and a dialog built ahead in an idle slice (:func:`_warm_the_preferences`) answers it in the next pass of the event loop, long before :meth:`setVisible`. The window sheet and the glass then walked all ~967 widgets of every tab in that one event: 425-484 ms offscreen, 0.36 s on the lesson capture host. The pages leave here as they would at the show, and the polish styles the open tab only.
records.translation: 미리 준비하는 과정은 표시되기 전에 polish합니다. Qt는 모든 새 위젯에 ``PolishRequest``를 게시하며, 유휴 구간에 미리 만든 대화 상자(:func:`_warm_the_preferences`)는 :meth:`setVisible`보다 훨씬 전에 이벤트 루프의 다음 패스에서 이에 응답합니다. 그러면 창 시트와 글래스가 그 한 이벤트에서 모든 탭의 위젯 ~967개를 전부 순회했습니다. offscreen에서 425-484 ms, 강좌 녹화 호스트에서 0.36 s였습니다. 여기서 페이지는 표시될 때와 같이 내보내지므로, polish는 열린 탭에만 스타일을 적용합니다.

records.context: Only for a dialog the warm-up built, which says so through ``_pages_leave_at_the_polish``. Anything else that builds the dialog and lets the event loop run before walking a page -- the help search index reads every tab's form rows that way -- still finds every page where the builder put it until the show.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences._preferences_window_class._PreferencesWindow.event#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ONLY FOR A DIALOG THE WARM-UP BUILT, which says so through ``_pages_leave_at_the_polish``. Anything else that builds the dialog and lets the event loop run before walking a page -- the help search index reads every tab's form rows that way -- still finds every page where the builder put it until the show.
records.translation: 미리 준비 과정이 만든 대화 상자에만 해당하며, 이는 ``_pages_leave_at_the_polish``로 알립니다. 대화 상자를 만들고 페이지를 순회하기 전에 이벤트 루프를 실행하게 두는 그 밖의 것 -- 도움말 검색 색인이 그런 방식으로 모든 탭의 양식 행을 읽습니다 -- 은 표시될 때까지 빌더가 둔 자리에서 모든 페이지를 그대로 찾습니다.

records.context: **Two keys answer this one question, and both are honoured.** The Animation preference gained a ``None`` entry (see :data:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.NO_ANIMATION`), and "no animation" has to mean *nothing is constructed* rather than "an engine that paints an empty frame sixty times a second". The three install sites all read this function before they build anything, so answering ``False`` for None here is what makes the guarantee true everywhere at once, without a second condition in three other modules that could drift apart.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.get_ambient_enabled#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Two keys answer this one question, and both are honoured.** The Animation preference gained a ``None`` entry (see :data:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.NO_ANIMATION`), and "no animation" has to mean *nothing is constructed* rather than "an engine that paints an empty frame sixty times a second". records.context: Read by :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue.render_figure_to_png`, which is the single consumer. ``pdf`` makes it write a vector page beside the display raster; the work list then rasterises that page for a crisper view and the user has a file that opens as editable art. records.context: What this reaches and what it does not. It is the colour of the figure's CHROME: the axis spines and the tick marks. It is deliberately not pushed over the data's own lines on every render, because a preference that repainted every series in one ink would flatten every multi-series figure in the package the first time a theme was read. The control that DOES reach the data's lines is the per-figure one (:func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_settings.apply_line_colour`), which is a user asking for it about one figure -- the same division as the pyqtgraph side, where the theme sets `_foreground` and `set_line_colour` is a menu entry.

records.context: Two consumers, and they treat it differently on purpose. :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue.render_figure_to_png` clamps it for the on-application view raster — a 16x12" figure at 300 DPI is a 4800 px PNG that costs more to decode than any application view can show — so a large figure is displayed at a lower DPI than the one chosen here. :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue._export_vector_pdf` uses the value unclamped, because the PDF is a file rather than a screenful and its embedded rasters really do need the resolution the user asked for.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.get_figure_png_dpi#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Two consumers, and they treat it differently on purpose. :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue.render_figure_to_png` clamps it for the on-screen raster — a 16x12" figure at 300 DPI is a 4800 px PNG that costs more to decode than any screen can show — so a large figure is displayed at a lower DPI than the one chosen here. :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue._export_vector_pdf` uses the value unclamped, because the PDF is a file rather than a screenful and its embedded rasters really do need the resolution the user asked for.
records.translation: 두 소비자가 있으며, 의도적으로 다르게 취급합니다. :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue.render_figure_to_png`는 화면용 래스터를 위해 이 값을 제한합니다 — 300 DPI의 16x12" 그림은 4800 px PNG로, 어떤 화면이 보여 줄 수 있는 것보다 디코딩 비용이 더 큽니다 — 따라서 큰 그림은 여기서 선택한 것보다 낮은 DPI로 표시됩니다. :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue._export_vector_pdf`는 값을 제한 없이 사용합니다. PDF는 화면 분량이 아니라 파일이며, 그 안에 포함된 래스터에는 사용자가 요청한 해상도가 정말로 필요하기 때문입니다.

records.context: An UPDATE against ``measurements.db`` is unrecoverable, so every guard below has to fail open to *read-only*:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#13
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: An UPDATE against ``measurements.db`` is unrecoverable, so every guard below has to fail open to *read-only*:
records.translation: ``measurements.db``에 대한 UPDATE는 복구할 수 없으므로, 아래의 모든 보호 장치는 실패 시 *읽기 전용*으로 열려야 합니다.

records.context: 1. :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_db_browser_editable` must be on — it is off by default and lives in Preferences, not on this screen. 2. The database must have been chosen explicitly in this session (``set_database(..., explicit=True)``). 3. The user must tick "Edit mode" *and* confirm; ticking alone does nothing. 4. The row must be addressable by ``rowid`` or a primary structured-data name. Without one, the edit is refused — an UPDATE matching on column values can hit many rows, which on a measurements table is silent mass corruption. The write also probes ``COUNT(*)`` for the row address first and rolls back unless ``rowcount == 1``. 5. The typed text must be coercible to the column's declared type. SQLite stores ``'abc'`` in an INTEGER column without error; :func:`coerce_for_column` refuses instead.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#14
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_db_browser_editable` must be on — it is off by default and lives in Preferences, not on this screen. 2. The database must have been chosen explicitly in this session (``set_database(..., explicit=True)``). 3. The user must tick "Edit mode" *and* confirm; ticking alone does nothing. 4. The row must be addressable by ``rowid`` or a primary key. Without one, the edit is refused — an UPDATE matching on column values can hit many rows, which on a measurements table is silent mass corruption. The write also probes ``COUNT(*)`` for the row address first and rolls back unless ``rowcount == 1``. 5. The typed text must be coercible to the column's declared type. SQLite stores ``'abc'`` in an INTEGER column without error; :func:`coerce_for_column` refuses instead.
records.translation: 1. :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_db_browser_editable`이 켜져 있어야 합니다 — 기본적으로 꺼져 있으며, 여기가 아니라 Preferences에 있습니다. 2. 데이터베이스는 이 세션에서 명시적으로 선택된 것이어야 합니다(``set_database(..., explicit=True)``). 3. 사용자가 "Edit mode"를 체크하고 *또한* 확인해야 합니다. 체크만으로는 아무 일도 일어나지 않습니다. 4. 행은 ``rowid`` 또는 기본 키로 지정할 수 있어야 합니다. 없으면 편집이 거부됩니다 — 열 값으로 대조하는 UPDATE는 여러 행에 적용될 수 있으며, 측정 테이블에서 이는 조용한 대량 손상입니다. 쓰기는 또한 먼저 행 주소에 대해 ``COUNT(*)``를 조회하고, ``rowcount == 1``이 아니면 롤백합니다. 5. 입력된 텍스트는 열의 선언된 유형으로 변환할 수 있어야 합니다. SQLite는 INTEGER 열에 ``'abc'``를 오류 없이 저장하지만, :func:`coerce_for_column`은 대신 거부합니다.

records.context: Design notes that matter for real spaCR databases:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Design notes that matter for real spaCR databases:
records.translation: 실제 spaCR 데이터베이스에서 중요한 설계 참고 사항:

records.context: **Keyset paging, not OFFSET.** Each chunk asks for ``rowid > <last rowid seen>`` and ``ORDER BY rowid``. ``LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`` makes SQLite walk (and throw away) every skipped row, so chunk 500 of a 400 k-row table would cost 500× chunk 1. Only tables with no usable structured-data name (views, composite-primary-structured-data name ``WITHOUT ROWID`` tables) fall back to ``OFFSET``, and those are small by construction.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Keyset paging, not OFFSET.** Each chunk asks for ``rowid > <last rowid seen>`` and ``ORDER BY rowid``. ``LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`` makes SQLite walk (and throw away) every skipped row, so chunk 500 of a 400 k-row table would cost 500× chunk 1. Only tables with no usable key (views, composite-primary-key ``WITHOUT ROWID`` tables) fall back to ``OFFSET``, and those are small by construction.
records.translation: **OFFSET이 아니라 키셋 페이지 매기기.** 각 청크는 ``rowid > <last rowid seen>``와 ``ORDER BY rowid``를 요청합니다. ``LIMIT ? OFFSET ?``는 SQLite가 건너뛴 모든 행을 순회(하고 버리게)하므로, 400 k행 테이블의 청크 500은 청크 1의 500× 비용이 듭니다. 사용할 수 있는 키가 없는 테이블(뷰, 복합 기본 키 ``WITHOUT ROWID`` 테이블)만 ``OFFSET``으로 대체되며, 이들은 구조상 작습니다.

records.context: **Cancellable.** Switching table or database bumps a load token. Results tagged with a stale token are dropped, so an in-flight load can never paint the previous table's rows into the new view, and a job that has not started yet is dropped without spending an independent execution path. Nothing is ever killed mid-flight.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Cancellable.** Switching table or database bumps a load token. Results tagged with a stale token are dropped, so an in-flight load can never paint the previous table's rows into the new view, and a job that has not started yet is dropped without spending a thread. Nothing is ever killed mid-flight.
records.translation: **취소 가능.** 테이블이나 데이터베이스를 바꾸면 로드 토큰이 증가합니다. 오래된 토큰이 붙은 결과는 버려지므로, 진행 중인 로드가 이전 테이블의 행을 새 뷰에 그리는 일은 결코 없으며, 아직 시작되지 않은 작업은 스레드를 소비하지 않고 버려집니다. 진행 중인 것을 강제로 종료하는 일은 결코 없습니다.

records.context: **Read-only by default, structurally.** Browsing connections are opened with the ``file:…?mode=ro`` URI *and* ``PRAGMA query_only = ON``. A write is rejected by SQLite itself, not by an application-level check. Editing is a separate, opt-in path (see below) with its own connection.

records.source: **Incremental fetch.** ``canFetchMore``/``fetchMore`` are Qt's incremental-loading interface; the view calls them when the user scrolls to the bottom and the model asks the screen for another chunk. While a chunk is in flight ``canFetchMore`` is False, so a scroll cannot queue ten of them.
records.translation: **점진적 가져오기.** ``canFetchMore``/``fetchMore``는 Qt의 점진적 로딩 인터페이스입니다. 사용자가 맨 아래로 스크롤하면 뷰가 이를 호출하고, 모델은 화면에 다음 청크를 요청합니다. 청크가 진행 중인 동안 ``canFetchMore``는 False이므로, 스크롤로 열 개를 대기열에 넣을 수 없습니다.

records.translation: 다섯 가지 규칙은 SQLite 파일 형식 명세에 있는 그대로이며, 순서대로입니다: ``INT`` → INTEGER, ``CHAR``/``CLOB``/``TEXT`` → TEXT, ``BLOB`` 또는 유형 없음 → BLOB, ``REAL``/``FLOA``/``DOUB`` → REAL, 그 밖에는 NUMERIC. 친화도를 알아야 :func:`coerce_for_column`이 SQLite가 다른 경우라면 잘못된 유형으로 저장할 값을 거부할 수 있습니다.

records.context: **Brush** and **Erase** paint and unpaint the active label a pixel at a time. **Erase object** removes a whole label in one click. **Wand** grows a region from the pixel clicked and adds it to the mask by default. Hold Ctrl while clicking to remove that region; the tolerance is relative to the image's intensity range by default, see :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.relative_tolerance`. **Draw** traces a free-form outline that closes and fills as ONE object -- the tool a brush is not, because a brush stamps disks along the path, so tracing a rim with it labels the rim and leaves the middle background. **Divide / Merge** uses a left-button drag to divide and a right-button drag to merge crossed objects under the first touched identifier without changing their pixels. The merged identity is retained when saving and reopening. Dividing drags a line across a merged object and makes it two, keeping the original identifier on the larger component and giving the smaller a new one, with every other object untouched; :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.DIVIDE_CUT_WIDTH` is the cut width. **Zoom** rectangle-drags the view and changes no labels at all.

Hold Ctrl while clicking to remove that region; the tolerance is relative to the image's intensity range by default, see :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.relative_tolerance`. **Draw** traces a free-form outline that closes and fills as ONE object -- the tool a brush is not, because a brush stamps disks along the path, so tracing a rim with it labels the rim and leaves the middle background. **Divide / Merge** uses a left-button drag to divide and a right-button drag to merge crossed objects under the first touched identifier without changing their pixels. The merged identity is retained when saving and reopening. Dividing drags a line across a merged object and makes it two, keeping the original identifier on the larger component and giving the smaller a new one, with every other object untouched; :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.DIVIDE_CUT_WIDTH` is the cut width. **Zoom** rectangle-drags the view and changes no labels at all.
records.translation: **Brush**와 **Erase**는 활성 레이블을 한 픽셀씩 칠하고 지웁니다. **Erase object**는 한 번의 클릭으로 레이블 전체를 제거합니다. **Wand**는 클릭한 픽셀에서 영역을 키워 기본적으로 마스크에 추가합니다. 그 영역을 제거하려면 Ctrl을 누른 채 클릭하십시오. 허용 오차는 기본적으로 이미지의 강도 범위에 대한 상대값입니다. :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.relative_tolerance`를 참조하십시오. **Draw**는 닫히고 채워져 하나의 객체가 되는 자유형 윤곽선을 그립니다 -- 브러시로는 할 수 없는 일입니다. 브러시는 경로를 따라 원판을 찍으므로, 브러시로 가장자리를 따라 그리면 가장자리만 레이블이 지정되고 가운데는 배경으로 남습니다. **Divide / Merge**는 왼쪽 버튼 드래그로 분할하고, 오른쪽 버튼 드래그로 가로지른 객체들을 픽셀을 바꾸지 않은 채 처음 닿은 식별자 아래로 병합합니다. 병합된 식별자는 저장하고 다시 열어도 유지됩니다. 분할은 병합된 객체를 가로질러 선을 그어 두 개로 만들며, 더 큰 구성 요소에는 원래 식별자를 유지하고 더 작은 구성 요소에는 새 식별자를 부여하고, 다른 모든 객체는 건드리지 않습니다. :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.DIVIDE_CUT_WIDTH`가 절단 너비입니다. **Zoom**은 사각형 드래그로 보기를 바꾸며 레이블은 전혀 바꾸지 않습니다.

records.context: **Recrop** is the ninth and is the only one that changes WHICH field is on application view rather than what is painted on it. A staged extracted image region holding several cells is not one training example, and curating it as one teaches a network that two objects are one picture -- so a box round an object writes that region of both the image and the mask as a field of its own (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.write_recrop`), queued straight after the current field, and the multi-object original is retired into ``recropped_originals/`` rather than curated (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.retire_recropped_original`). A box shorter than :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MIN_SIDE` on a side, or repeating a cut already made past :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MAX_OVERLAP`, is refused; objects the box cuts through are dropped, because an object whose boundary is where the mouse was released is not that object; and the labels that survive are renumbered from one.

records.source: **Recrop** is the ninth and is the only one that changes WHICH field is on screen rather than what is painted on it. A staged crop holding several cells is not one training example, and curating it as one teaches a network that two objects are one picture -- so a box round an object writes that region of both the image and the mask as a field of its own (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.write_recrop`), queued straight after the current field, and the multi-object original is retired into ``recropped_originals/`` rather than curated (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.retire_recropped_original`). A box shorter than :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MIN_SIDE` on a side, or repeating a cut already made past :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MAX_OVERLAP`, is refused; objects the box cuts through are dropped, because an object whose boundary is where the mouse was released is not that object; and the labels that survive are renumbered from one.
records.translation: **Recrop**은 아홉 번째 도구이며, 화면에 칠해진 내용이 아니라 화면에 표시되는 시야 자체를 바꾸는 유일한 도구입니다. 세포 여러 개를 담은 준비된 크롭은 하나의 학습 예시가 아니며, 이를 하나로 큐레이션하면 네트워크에 두 객체가 하나의 그림이라고 가르치게 됩니다 -- 따라서 객체를 둘러싼 상자는 이미지와 마스크의 그 영역을 모두 독립된 시야로 작성하고(:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.write_recrop`), 현재 시야 바로 다음 순서로 대기열에 넣으며, 여러 객체가 담긴 원본은 큐레이션하지 않고 ``recropped_originals/``로 보관합니다(:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.retire_recropped_original`). 한 변이 :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MIN_SIDE`보다 짧은 상자나, 이미 만든 절단을 :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MAX_OVERLAP` 이상 반복하는 상자는 거부됩니다. 상자가 가로지르는 객체는 제외됩니다. 경계가 마우스를 놓은 위치에 있는 객체는 원래 그 객체가 아니기 때문입니다. 남은 레이블은 1부터 다시 번호가 매겨집니다.

records.context: Every module that was built, not every module that was opened. A module is built the moment something asks this application view to point it at the open folder — :meth:`seed_folded` does, and so does any test or caller reaching for :meth:`folded_screen` — and pointing Model Compare at a folder starts a load independent execution path before its panel has ever been on application view. Walking the panels alone left those independent execution paths executing with nothing holding them, and the process died of it several actions later, in whatever happened to be executing when the memory behind them was touched.

records.source: EVERY MODULE THAT WAS BUILT, not every module that was opened. A module is built the moment something asks this screen to point it at the open folder — :meth:`seed_folded` does, and so does any test or caller reaching for :meth:`folded_screen` — and pointing Model Compare at a folder starts a load thread before its panel has ever been on screen. Walking the panels alone left those threads running with nothing holding them, and the process died of it several actions later, in whatever happened to be running when the memory behind them was touched.
records.translation: 열린 모든 모듈이 아니라 만들어진 모든 모듈입니다. 무언가가 이 화면에 모듈을 열린 폴더로 향하게 하라고 요청하는 순간 모듈이 만들어지며 — :meth:`seed_folded`가 그렇게 하고, :meth:`folded_screen`을 호출하는 테스트나 호출자도 마찬가지입니다 — Model Compare를 폴더로 향하게 하면 그 패널이 화면에 표시되기도 전에 로드 스레드가 시작됩니다. 패널만 순회하면 그 스레드들이 아무것도 붙잡지 않은 채 실행 중으로 남았고, 프로세스는 몇 동작 뒤 그 메모리가 접근되는 순간 실행 중이던 작업 도중에 그 때문에 종료되었습니다.

records.source: **Its height floor is in the QSS, not here.** ``setFixedSize`` does not survive polish, and neither does answering through ``sizeHint`` / ``minimumSizeHint``: the app stylesheet's blanket ``QPushButton { min-height: 22px }`` becomes a real ``setMinimumHeight(22)``, and ``qSmartMinSize`` lets an explicit minimum override the hints. On a page that does not fit, every tile then collapses to 22 px and paints its name over its icon. See :data:`spacr.qt.theme.TILE_H`. The hints below are still worth having — they are what the layout *prefers* — and ``heightForWidth`` is overridden with them because ``QWidgetItem::sizeHint`` reads it in preference to ``sizeHint().height()`` whenever it is available.
records.translation: **높이 하한은 여기가 아니라 QSS에 있습니다.** ``setFixedSize``는 polish 후에 유지되지 않으며, ``sizeHint`` / ``minimumSizeHint``로 답하는 것도 마찬가지입니다. 앱 스타일시트의 일괄 ``QPushButton { min-height: 22px }``이 실제 ``setMinimumHeight(22)``가 되고, ``qSmartMinSize``는 명시적 최솟값이 힌트를 재정의하게 합니다. 그러면 들어맞지 않는 페이지에서 모든 타일이 22 px로 줄어들고 이름이 아이콘 위에 그려집니다. :data:`spacr.qt.theme.TILE_H`를 참조하십시오. 아래의 힌트는 여전히 가치가 있으며 — 레이아웃이 *선호하는* 크기입니다 — ``heightForWidth``도 그 힌트로 재정의됩니다. ``QWidgetItem::sizeHint``가 사용 가능할 때마다 ``sizeHint().height()``보다 이를 우선하여 읽기 때문입니다.

records.context: The notes are bundled, and the bundle is what is drawn. They come from ``spacr/resources/release_notes.json``, which ``tools/build_release_notes.py`` writes from the GitHub releases and which ``.github/workflows/release.yml`` refreshes on every release. This panel is on the first screen the application shows; content read from api.github.com would be empty offline, rate-limited behind a shared NAT, and slower to draw than the window. The bundled file therefore remains the offline source and the panel is complete before any network access.

records.context: Newer releases are then added. The wheel for a release cannot contain its own release note -- the note is written when the GitHub release is published, which is after that wheel is on PyPI -- so a bundled file is always one release behind the build carrying it. After the page is shown, :attr:`refresh_requested` asks the window to read the public releases list on a background execution unit, and :meth:`apply_releases` merges whatever comes back in front of the bundled list. Nothing here opens a socket: the panel only asks, and a fetch that fails, is rate-limited, is switched off in Preferences, or simply finds nothing newer leaves the bundled list exactly as it was drawn.

records.context: This is not a Markdown renderer. Release bodies are GitHub-flavoured markdown; what they contain in practice is bullet lists, bare URLs and ``**bold**``, and a QLabel understands a handful of tags. So: escape everything first -- a body is text from a web page and must never reach a rich-text widget as markup -- then put back the three constructs that are worth having.

records.translation: 이것은 Markdown 렌더러가 아닙니다. 릴리스 본문은 GitHub 스타일 markdown이며, 실제로 담고 있는 것은 글머리 목록, 그대로 쓴 URL 및 ``**bold**``이고, QLabel은 몇 가지 태그만 이해합니다. 따라서 먼저 모든 것을 이스케이프하고 -- 본문은 웹 페이지의 텍스트이므로 결코 마크업으로 서식 있는 텍스트 위젯에 도달해서는 안 됩니다 -- 그다음 가치 있는 세 가지 구성 요소를 되살립니다.

records.source: **On the Pause button.** It is enabled if and only if the running job's entry point declares itself ``bridge.pausable`` — i.e. it actually polls ``bridge.checkpoint()``. No shipped pipeline does, so today it renders disabled with :data:`PAUSE_UNAVAILABLE` as its tooltip: a Pause button that stopped the thread wherever it happened to be would not be a safe pause, so the control is shown disabled with the reason.
records.translation: **Pause 버튼에 관하여.** 실행 중인 작업의 진입점이 스스로를 ``bridge.pausable``로 선언하는 경우 — 즉 실제로 ``bridge.checkpoint()``를 폴링하는 경우 — 에만 활성화됩니다. 제공되는 파이프라인 중 그렇게 하는 것은 없으므로, 현재는 :data:`PAUSE_UNAVAILABLE`을 툴팁으로 하여 비활성화된 상태로 렌더링됩니다. 스레드를 우연히 있던 곳에서 멈추는 Pause 버튼은 안전한 일시 중지가 아니므로, 컨트롤은 이유와 함께 비활성화된 상태로 표시됩니다.
